from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
base=Path('data/goodbooks-10k')
books=pd.read_csv(base/'books.csv')
ratings=pd.read_csv(base/'ratings.csv')
toread=pd.read_csv(base/'to_read.csv')
book_tags=pd.read_csv(base/'book_tags.csv')
tags=pd.read_csv(base/'tags.csv')
print('pandas', pd.__version__)
print('books rows', len(books))
req=['original_title','authors','average_rating','ratings_count','ratings_1','ratings_2','ratings_3','ratings_4','ratings_5']
print('missing required')
print(books[req].isna().sum().to_string())
nonmiss=books[books[req].notna().all(axis=1)].copy()
dup_mask=nonmiss['original_title'].duplicated(keep=False)
print('nonmissing required rows', len(nonmiss))
print('duplicate exact original_title rows among required', int(dup_mask.sum()))
print('duplicate exact title groups among required', int(nonmiss.loc[dup_mask,'original_title'].nunique()))
print('clean book rows after duplicate-title removal', len(nonmiss.loc[~dup_mask]))
print('language missing required rows', int(nonmiss['language_code'].isna().sum()))
print('publication year missing required rows', int(nonmiss['original_publication_year'].isna().sum()))
pair_counts=ratings.groupby(['user_id','book_id'], sort=False).size()
repeated=pair_counts[pair_counts.gt(1)]
print('ratings rows', len(ratings))
print('duplicate user/book pairs', len(repeated))
print('rating rows in repeated pairs to remove', int(repeated.sum()))
print('ratings rows after full-pair removal', len(ratings) - int(repeated.sum()))
tr_pairs=toread.groupby(['user_id','book_id'], sort=False).size()
print('to_read rows', len(toread), 'duplicate pairs', int(tr_pairs.gt(1).sum()), 'rows in duplicate pairs', int(tr_pairs[tr_pairs.gt(1)].sum()) if tr_pairs.gt(1).any() else 0)
print('book_tags rows', len(book_tags), 'tags rows', len(tags))
PY"
